verdict.detail: Discogs lists 11 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
This version contains an inner sleeve with the patent number:
1,125,555 4913 000 1541 — 3 539

Issued in a textured gimmix cover with pinched spine endings.
The center part of the punched out front being transparent foil with black print on it; there is a printed cardboard insert that provides the remainder of the cover image.
Release also contains a printed inner sleeve with lyrics.

Track B4 is not mentioned on release, but the music is present on the record.

Some copies were issued with a "Made in England" sticker on the back cover.

Runouts are stamped apart from 'RAYS,' which is etched.

On the back cover:
All songs for Alucard Music
An Alucard Production
Recorded at Advision Studios, London. July '73.
Recording produced by W.W.A. Records and marketed by Phonogram
Printed and made in England

On the labels:
Produced for Alucard Productions
All compositions published by Alucard Music Ltd.
℗ 1973

On the inner sleeve: 
PATENT Nos. 1,125,555  4913 000 1541 — 3 539 Made in Great Britain
